supplements.title: Prognostic impact of weight loss during radiation therapy in patients with head and neck cancer: A systematic review.
supplements.summary: In head and neck cancer patients, weight loss greater than 10% before radiation therapy consistently predicts worse survival outcomes.

supplements.title: Insights into the potential mechanism of Beiqishen Jiangtang Granule in the treatment of type 2 diabetes nephropathy: A study based on network pharmacology, molecular docking, and biological validation.
supplements.summary: Beiqishen Jiangtang Granule helps manage type 2 diabetes by regulating insulin, inflammatory markers, and gut microbiota through multiple molecular pathways.

supplements.title: Potential mechanisms of Si-Wu-Tang against esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: A machine learning pharmacological study.
supplements.summary: Si-Wu-Tang may combat esophageal cancer by targeting key genes like CDK1, affecting multiple signaling pathways and the tumor immune environment.

supplements.title: Synergistic anticancer effects of tamoxifen in combination with fisetin and chrysin on breast cancer cells: insights into viability, migration, and apoptosis.
supplements.summary: Combining tamoxifen with fisetin and chrysin significantly enhanced breast cancer cell death and reduced cancer cell migration and survival.

supplements.title: Noninvasive Salivary Ketone Monitoring: A Ratiometric Pdot Biosensor toward Personalized Ketogenic Management.
supplements.summary: A novel saliva-based sensor can quickly and accurately detect ketone levels, offering a noninvasive method for monitoring metabolic health and diet management.

supplements.title: Impact of Diet and Drugs on Fecal Lachnoclostridium Gene Marker (m3) in Non-Invasive Diagnosis of Colorectal Neoplasia.
supplements.summary: A specific bacterial gene marker could help diagnose colorectal cancer and precancerous growths through a non-invasive test.

supplements.title: Mechanistic insights into the anti-inflammatory effects of isocoronarin D associated with reduced PKCδ and PI3K/Akt signalling in LPS-activated macrophages.
supplements.summary: Isocoronarin D from Curcuma comosa demonstrates anti-inflammatory effects by reducing inflammatory proteins and signaling pathways in macrophage cells.

supplements.title: Date palm pollen extract improves fertility and pregnancy outcomes in letrozole-induced polycystic ovary syndrome rats.
supplements.summary: Date palm pollen extract effectively restored hormonal balance, reduced inflammation, and improved fertility in rats with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).

supplements.title: Probabilistic dietary exposure assessment of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and its associated disease burden in Singapore.
supplements.summary: Research found that dietary exposure to polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) in Singaporean food poses a relatively low lifetime cancer risk.

supplements.title: Colonic spatial single-cell proteomics and murine models link mitochondrial dysfunction to dimeric IgA-secreting plasma cell deficiency in Crohn's disease.
supplements.summary: Crohn's disease patients have reduced dimeric IgA production due to mitochondrial dysfunction, which impairs plasma cell maturation in the colon.

supplements.title: Association of dietary choline intake with all-cause and disease-specific mortality among individuals with diabetes: a population-based prospective cohort study.
supplements.summary: For adults with diabetes, moderate dietary choline intake (286-539 mg/day) is associated with lower all-cause mortality risk compared to very low or very high intake levels.

supplements.title: The effect of a person-centred lifestyle programme on cancer-related fatigue in colorectal cancer survivors: a randomised trial.
supplements.summary: A personalized lifestyle coaching program for colorectal cancer survivors improved diet and activity but did not significantly reduce cancer-related fatigue or improve quality of life.

supplements.title: Higher adherence to core food-based vegetarian and prudent dietary patterns is associated with lower adiposity and metabolic disease risk in Pacific and New Zealand European women.
supplements.summary: Higher adherence to vegetarian and prudent dietary patterns with core foods was linked to lower body fat and reduced metabolic disease risk in Pacific and NZ European women.

supplements.title: Folate receptor-α targeted delivery of berberine via folate-functionalized bovine serum albumin nanocarriers to enhance intracellular internalization and suppress 3D spheroid formation as a pioneering therapeutic modality for glioblastoma.
supplements.summary: Folic acid-modified nanoparticles delivering berberine specifically target and effectively suppress glioblastoma cell growth by enhancing cellular uptake and inducing apoptosis.

supplements.title: Assessment of the protective effects of tannic acid against bleomycin-induced lung fibrosis in rats.
supplements.summary: Tannic acid significantly reduced lung fibrosis markers and inflammation in rats, offering potential protective effects against bleomycin-induced pulmonary damage.

off_label.title: Regorafenib and Nifuroxazide exert enhanced suppression of hepatocellular carcinoma by inhibiting STAT3 and immune remodeling.
off_label.summary: Combining low-dose Regorafenib with Nifuroxazide effectively suppresses hepatocellular carcinoma by inhibiting STAT3 and enhancing anti-tumor immune responses.

off_label.title: Precision screening identifies mitoxantrone as a multitarget inhibitor in ageing-associated cancers with extensive computational validation and doxorubicin comparison.
off_label.summary: Mitoxantrone shows promise as a potential multi-target drug for treating ageing-associated cancers, demonstrating superior performance compared to doxorubicin through computational analysis.

off_label.title: In-silico target prediction and pathway analysis of propranolol as a potential therapeutic agent for hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Propranolol shows potential to target key cancer-driving proteins in hepatocellular carcinoma, suggesting it could be a promising therapeutic drug.

off_label.title: Insights into the potential mechanism of Beiqishen Jiangtang Granule in the treatment of type 2 diabetes nephropathy: A study based on network pharmacology, molecular docking, and biological validation.
off_label.summary: Beiqishen Jiangtang Granule helps manage type 2 diabetes by regulating insulin, inflammatory markers, and gut microbiota through multiple molecular pathways.

off_label.title: Nicotine pouches: an aid in smoking cessation, or a new public health hazard?
off_label.summary: Nicotine pouches offer a potentially lower-risk alternative to smoking, with reduced toxicant exposure and promising harm reduction potential for smokers unable to quit.

off_label.title: Adherence to Dental Care in Head and Neck Cancer Patients Post-Radiation Therapy: A Scoping Review.
off_label.summary: Patients with head and neck cancer often struggle to follow dental care guidelines after radiation therapy, which can impact their overall recovery and health.

off_label.title: Continuous glucose monitoring reveals bimodal glycemic patterns during and outside Capivasertib administration.
off_label.summary: Continuous glucose monitoring revealed unique blood sugar changes during capivasertib treatment, showing post-dose glucose spikes and next-morning hypoglycemia.

off_label.title: Clinical outcomes and genomic alterations in patients with metastatic malignant phyllodes tumors.
off_label.summary: Genomic profiling of rare metastatic phyllodes breast tumors reveals potential targeted treatment insights, though standard therapy remains undefined.

off_label.title: CXCR2 affects sensitization of radioresistant HPV-negative head and neck squamous cell carcinoma cells by ABT-263.
off_label.summary: ABT-263 targets the CXCR2 pathway to sensitize radiation-resistant HPV-negative head and neck cancer cells to treatment.

off_label.title: The antitumor mechanism of oclacitinib in canine lymphoma.
off_label.summary: Oclacitinib inhibits cancer cell growth in canine lymphoma by blocking JAK1/STAT5 signaling, potentially offering a new treatment approach for certain lymphoma types.

off_label.title: The influence of paternal preconception health on birth defects and head circumference: A scoping review.
off_label.summary: Paternal preconception health factors like metabolic syndrome, smoking, and environmental exposures can significantly increase risks of congenital birth defects in offspring.

off_label.title: Neratinib, a Clinical Drug Treating Breast Cancer, Protects Against Vascular Inflammation and Atherosclerosis.
off_label.summary: Neratinib, a breast cancer drug, demonstrates potential to reduce vascular inflammation and slow atherosclerosis progression by targeting key inflammatory pathways.

off_label.title: Mass Spectrometry Monitoring of Water Dimer Radical Cations for Highly Efficient Dye Degradation.
off_label.summary: Water dimer radical cations efficiently degraded rhodamine B dye, achieving 99% removal in 8 minutes without additional chemicals, using a corona discharge method.

off_label.title: Current and Future Pharmacological Interventions for Acquired Hypothalamic Obesity.
off_label.summary: Emerging pharmacological therapies targeting disturbed brain pathways show promise in treating acquired hypothalamic obesity by addressing unique metabolic disruptions.

off_label.title: Impact of prenatal sirolimus on cardiac rhabdomyomas and brain tubers.
off_label.summary: Prenatal sirolimus treatment reduced tumor size and improved cardiac outcomes in fetuses with cardiac rhabdomyomas associated with tuberous sclerosis complex.

biomarkers.title: Exosomal circ_001895 from lung cancer cells drives M2 macrophage polarization via the miR-20a-5p/JAK1/STAT3 axis to promote tumor progression.
biomarkers.summary: Exosomes play a vital role in cancer cell and tumor microenvironment (TME) crosstalk.

biomarkers.title: Chronotype and sleep duration in relation to leukaemia subtypes: a two-sample Mendelian randomization analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Several observational studies have suggested an association between sleep traits and leukaemia.

biomarkers.title: Clinical Features and Biomarkers Associated With Intensive Care-Dependent Refractory NMDAR Encephalitis: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
biomarkers.summary: A subset of patients with NMDAR encephalitis is resistant to first-line and second-line immunotherapy and requires prolonged intensive care.

biomarkers.title: Impact of the intratumoral resident microbiome on the immune microenvironment of malignant tumors (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Advances in cancer research have highlighted the importance of tumor‑intrinsic factors, including tumor type, immune environment, immunogenicity, metabolic demands and the intratumoral microbiome.

biomarkers.title: Suppressive role of SCN4B in the epithelial‑mesenchymal transition of lung adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: In lung adenocarcinoma, low SCN4B expression promotes cancer cell migration and invasion, while restoring SCN4B levels suppresses tumor progression.

biomarkers.title: Regorafenib and Nifuroxazide exert enhanced suppression of hepatocellular carcinoma by inhibiting STAT3 and immune remodeling.
biomarkers.summary: Combining low-dose Regorafenib with Nifuroxazide effectively suppresses hepatocellular carcinoma by inhibiting STAT3 and enhancing anti-tumor immune responses.

biomarkers.title: Liquid biopsy in malignant primary bone tumors: Clinical applications of circulating tumor DNA and circulating tumor cells for diagnosis, prognosis and treatment monitoring (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Liquid biopsy provides a noninvasive method to detect, monitor, and predict outcomes for bone cancers by analyzing circulating tumor DNA and cells.

biomarkers.title: Tumor visualization and evaluation of glioblastoma in mice using small animal 9.4T MRI and PET‑CT with high resolution.
biomarkers.summary: High-resolution PET-CT and MRI effectively visualized and tracked glioblastoma tumor growth and metabolism in mice over 21 days.

biomarkers.title: Research progress on long non‑coding RNAs in lung cancer (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Long non-coding RNAs show significant potential as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in lung cancer, influencing tumor progression and treatment response.

biomarkers.title: Role of SPAG6 in regulating physiological functions and tumorigenesis (Review).
biomarkers.summary: SPAG6 protein plays a critical role in cancer progression, potentially serving as a diagnostic marker and therapeutic target across multiple cancer types.

biomarkers.title: Chorus line in oral squamous cell carcinoma: How stromal and immune players orchestrate tumor progression (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Cancer-associated fibroblasts and PD-L1 in oral squamous cell carcinoma collaborate to promote tumor growth, spread, and resistance to treatment.

biomarkers.title: miRNA‑29a inhibits the proliferation of HUVECs by regulating the ITGB1/β‑catenin/c‑Myc pathway.
biomarkers.summary: miRNA-29a inhibits the growth of blood vessel cells in infantile hemangioma by targeting and disrupting a specific cellular signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: Emerging roles of RNA m6A modification in multiple myeloma pathogenesis and treatment resistance (Review).
biomarkers.summary: RNA m6A modifications significantly influence multiple myeloma's progression, drug resistance, and potential treatment strategies by regulating key cellular processes.

biomarkers.title: Association of Systemic Inflammatory Markers With Cerebral Small Vessel Disease Progression: A Community-Based Prospective Study.
biomarkers.summary: Higher levels of inflammatory markers like neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio were linked to increased progression of cerebral small vessel disease in this community-based study.

biomarkers.title: DEprot: a comprehensive R-package for the analysis of label-free quantitation mass spectrometry data.
biomarkers.summary: DEprot is a new R-package that helps researchers analyze protein interaction data more accurately by improving methods for handling missing protein information.

trials.title: PD-1 Inhibitors in Orbital and Periocular Squamous Cell Carcinoma: A Review.
trials.summary: PD-1 inhibitors show promise as a targeted therapy for advanced periocular and orbital squamous cell carcinoma, potentially offering a less invasive treatment alternative.

trials.title: TCRγ constant usage tunes human γδ T cell antigen sensitivity, thymic programming, and peripheral function.
trials.summary: Human γδ T cell receptor constant regions (Cγ1 and Cγ2) independently influence cell activation, differentiation, and function across thymic development and peripheral tissues.

trials.title: De novo identification of the specificities of recurrently identified human T cell receptors.
trials.summary: Researchers identified the specific viral targets of rare, shared T cell receptors, revealing common immune responses to viruses like seasonal coronaviruses and influenza.
